definition: The religious path, tradition, and way of life itself; it is not identical with any corporation, leader, building, document, or generation.
preferred_usage: walk the Way; teachings of the Way; the Way teaches/practices
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as though it were the legal corporation or proprietary possession.
crosswalk: Replaces broader predecessor identity names as the native name of the religious path.

definition: A person who freely identifies with and undertakes to walk the Way with others while retaining conscience and freedom of departure.
preferred_usage: a Companion; Companion of the Way; become a Companion
avoid_or_caution: Does not by itself create Covenant Membership, statutory corporate membership, office, voting rights, or spiritual rank.
crosswalk: Native personal identity; broader than formal Covenant Membership.

definition: Companions collectively.
preferred_usage: the Companions; Companions of the Way
avoid_or_caution: Do not imply a spiritual caste or governing body.

definition: The religious community formed by Companions and welcome participants gathered around the Way; broader than the legal corporation and distinct from the Board.
preferred_usage: the Assembly gathers; life of the Assembly; the Assembly teaches
avoid_or_caution: Never use as a synonym for the nonprofit corporation, Board, or Covenant Member Assembly.
crosswalk: Current native community term; supersedes generic predecessor movement/community names for ordinary religious-community prose.

definition: Compound public-facing working name joining the community and tradition; used in current pilot materials.
preferred_usage: The Assembly of the Way; a gathering of the Assembly of the Way
avoid_or_caution: Do not append Inc. unless referring to a verified legal entity; do not treat working-name usage as incorporation or trademark status.
crosswalk: Public-facing expansion of The Assembly + The Way.

definition: A stable local expression of the Assembly: the local religious community/congregation and, secondarily, the place where it gathers.
preferred_usage: a House of Prayer; House of Prayer at [place]
avoid_or_caution: A House of Prayer need not own a building and is not a separate legal entity unless expressly organized as one. When referring to real estate, say House of Prayer site/facility where needed.
crosswalk: Preferred native term for a stable local community; maps externally to congregation when required.

definition: Multiple local expressions of the Assembly.
preferred_usage: the Houses of Prayer; network of Houses of Prayer
avoid_or_caution: Do not imply a federation or jurisdictional hierarchy until one is actually constituted.

definition: A particular meeting for prayer, study, fellowship, service, discernment, formation, or another recognized purpose.
preferred_usage: Gathering for Prayer; weekly Gathering; Founding Gathering Circle
avoid_or_caution: A gathering is not automatically a House of Prayer, congregation, membership meeting, or corporate meeting.

definition: The current pre-incorporation adult pilot/gathering framework used to test formation, operations, safeguarding, and reproducibility.
avoid_or_caution: Must not be described as an incorporated entity, recognized House of Prayer, statutory membership body, or tax-exempt organization unless those facts later become true.
crosswalk: Current pilot term in releases v1.4–v1.6.

term: House of Prayer for All Peoples
definition: A fuller scriptural/theological expression associated with the inclusive vision behind House of Prayer.
avoid_or_caution: Use as inherited scriptural language, not as an exclusive proprietary brand.
crosswalk: Ceremonial expansion of House of Prayer.

definition: Required placeholder for the legal corporation name until a name is verified and the corporation is actually formed/authorized.
preferred_usage: use exactly [[CORP_NAME]] in legal drafts until resolved
avoid_or_caution: Do not silently replace with a preferred public name in filing/adoption documents.

term: The Assembly of the Way, Inc.
definition: Candidate form of the legal nonprofit corporate name if ultimately verified, selected, and formed under that name.
preferred_usage: Only after verified legal formation; before then describe as candidate
avoid_or_caution: Do not present as the existing legal entity while ORG.LEGAL_NAME remains unresolved.
crosswalk: Candidate legal form derived from working public name.
decision_required: Yes — Tennessee name/legal formation verification and final selection

definition: The nonprofit corporation that may legally support the religious community and hold civil rights, duties, property, contracts, and fiduciary obligations.
avoid_or_caution: Do not equate with the Way or the Assembly.
crosswalk: Civil legal entity; distinct from religious community.

definition: Generic legal/public descriptor for an organization organized for religious purposes.
avoid_or_caution: Not the preferred native proper name of the religious community.

definition: External legal, tax, historical, or comparative term; may describe a claimed IRS classification or another tradition's institution.
preferred_usage: IRS church classification; church characteristics; Christian church
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as the default native name of the Assembly unless a specific document requires the category; never imply IRS recognition before established.

definition: External/legal or ordinary descriptive term for people who regularly gather as a local religious community.
preferred_usage: congregation when required by IRS, insurer, venue, or comparative prose
avoid_or_caution: Do not treat congregation, House of Prayer, Companion, or Covenant Member as automatically identical categories.
crosswalk: External analogue to a stable local House of Prayer; factual meaning depends on actual practice.

definition: A member of the nonprofit corporation under applicable corporate law, if the corporation is structured to have such members.
preferred_usage: statutory corporate member; corporation has/has no statutory members
avoid_or_caution: Never abbreviate simply to member where confusion with Covenant Membership is possible.
crosswalk: Current draft design says Covenant Membership is distinct; actual corporate structure must be verified in filed charter/bylaws.

definition: The civil governing board of the nonprofit corporation with powers and fiduciary duties assigned by law and civil governing instruments.
avoid_or_caution: Not the Assembly, Ecclesiastical Council, clergy, or membership body.

definition: Permitted shorthand for Board of Directors once defined.
avoid_or_caution: Do not use for a religious council.
crosswalk: Short form of Board of Directors.

definition: A person who takes part in a gathering, program, practice, or community activity without necessarily claiming Companion or Covenant Member status.
avoid_or_caution: Participation alone does not create membership, office, assent, or governance rights.

definition: Religious identity for a person walking the Way with others.
avoid_or_caution: Do not collapse into Covenant Member or statutory corporate member.
crosswalk: Identity layer before/formally outside membership status.

definition: A person admitted into the Assembly's formal ecclesiastical Covenant Membership under MEM-001 and related instruments.
avoid_or_caution: Never shorten to member in documents where corporate membership could be confused. Covenant Membership does not itself create ownership or statutory corporate membership.
crosswalk: Formal ecclesiastical membership status. Drafting rule: ordinarily a formal subset of Companions, while not every Companion must be a Covenant Member.
decision_required: Yes — confirm exact Companion/Covenant-Member eligibility relationship in MEM-001 reconciliation

definition: The formal ecclesiastical membership system governed by MEM-001 and its Covenant/procedures.
preferred_usage: enter Covenant Membership; Covenant Membership status
avoid_or_caution: Do not describe it as corporate ownership, irrevocable vow, or automatic office eligibility beyond rules actually adopted.
crosswalk: Formal membership layer distinct from Companion identity and statutory corporate membership.

definition: The formal participatory ecclesiastical governance body composed of eligible Covenant Members under the constitutional system.
avoid_or_caution: Never use The Assembly as shorthand for CMA; The Assembly is the broader religious community.
crosswalk: CMA-001 formal governance body within the Assembly.

definition: Abbreviation for Covenant Member Assembly after the full name is defined in a document.
avoid_or_caution: Do not use before definition in public-facing documents.

definition: Ambiguous term that can refer to religious membership, statutory corporate membership, or ordinary affiliation.
preferred_usage: Use Covenant Member, statutory corporate member, participant, Companion, or another precise term instead.
avoid_or_caution: Avoid standing alone in governing/legal documents.

definition: Possible voluntary public statement by which an adult identifies as a Companion.
avoid_or_caution: Not an irrevocable vow; not required unless later adopted; does not itself create statutory membership.
crosswalk: Historical/current candidate in foundational source work.
decision_required: Yes — final form and relationship to Covenant Membership

definition: Generic technical term used throughout some current constitutional drafts for the religious community associated with the corporation.
preferred_usage: Use only where already defined pending reconciliation
avoid_or_caution: Prefer The Assembly or religious community in final prose unless a technical distinction requires Religious Body. Do not leave it undefined.
crosswalk: Legacy/current drafting synonym that must be crosswalked to The Assembly.

definition: Name of the current draft governance model in which authority is rule-bound, distributed by competence, and exercised through defined councils and offices.
avoid_or_caution: Not a public identity name and not evidence of adoption by itself.

definition: The person who originated the present institutional project; a historical relation, not by itself a religious office.
avoid_or_caution: Founder status alone does not create doctrinal infallibility, ministry credential, ownership, disciplinary immunity, or legal authority not granted elsewhere.
crosswalk: Current native lexicon and constitutional anti-capture usage.
decision_required: Yes — exact founder-era reserved powers, if any, belong in PR-AUTH not in the word itself

definition: Current draft title for the principal ecclesiastical leadership office in later governance instruments.
preferred_usage: Presiding Spiritual Leader; PSL after definition
avoid_or_caution: REL-CON-001 itself flags the final title as unresolved; do not treat the title as permanently settled.
crosswalk: Later governance term; not identical with Founder.

definition: Abbreviation for Presiding Spiritual Leader after definition.
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as a public title without first spelling it out.

definition: Current draft collective body for major ecclesiastical governance and discernment under ECC-CON-001.
avoid_or_caution: Do not imply authority over civil matters outside its defined jurisdiction.
crosswalk: Current later governance body; likely successor to earlier generic Council of the Assembly concept.

definition: Abbreviation for Ecclesiastical Council after definition.
avoid_or_caution: Avoid unexplained abbreviation in public documents.

definition: Current draft body for constitutional/jurisdictional review.
avoid_or_caution: Do not describe as a civil court or holder of powers not granted in governing instruments.

definition: Abbreviation for Council of Constitutional Guardians after definition.
avoid_or_caution: Avoid unexplained abbreviation in public documents.

definition: Current draft independent ecclesiastical body for serious misconduct/accountability functions.
avoid_or_caution: Does not replace civil authorities, mandated reporting, law enforcement, or independent professional processes where applicable.

definition: Abbreviation for Ecclesiastical Accountability Council after definition.
avoid_or_caution: Avoid unexplained abbreviation in public documents.

definition: Earlier candidate term for a religious deliberative body.
preferred_usage: Use only when describing historical design evolution
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as a second competing name for the Ecclesiastical Council unless PR-XWALK explicitly preserves a separate body.
crosswalk: Earlier vocabulary likely absorbed/replaced by later council architecture.

definition: Possible representative body connecting multiple Houses of Prayer after multiple Houses actually exist.
preferred_usage: Council of Houses if later constituted
avoid_or_caution: Do not imply it exists now.
decision_required: Yes — only when community scale warrants

definition: Possible geographic coordination layer among multiple Houses of Prayer.
preferred_usage: Appalachian Regional Assembly, if later constituted
avoid_or_caution: Do not create jurisdictional hierarchy merely through terminology.

definition: A person formally entrusted with defined religious functions such as prayer, pastoral care, worship, teaching, rites, or service.
avoid_or_caution: Should denote accountable function, not sacred caste or unlimited spiritual authority.

definition: A person recognized or assigned to teach within demonstrated competence.
preferred_usage: Teacher of history; Teacher in a House of Prayer
avoid_or_caution: Teaching authority remains bounded by scope, sources, review, and correction.

definition: A person entrusted with resources, administration, property, operations, or another defined communal responsibility.
avoid_or_caution: Custody on behalf of others, not ownership or spiritual rank.

definition: Possible role recognizing maturity, wisdom, long service, and sound judgment.
preferred_usage: Elder of the Assembly, only if later adopted
avoid_or_caution: No automatic executive, fiduciary, revelatory, or disciplinary authority.

definition: Formal authorization for a defined ministry or service under the current working model.
preferred_usage: commission a Minister; letter of commissioning
avoid_or_caution: Authorization must remain scoped, accountable, and reviewable; it is not ordination unless explicitly so defined.
crosswalk: Current authorization model pending ordination theology.

definition: Possible future religious act/status for ordained ministry if theology and practice warrant it.
avoid_or_caution: Do not manufacture merely to imitate other religions or obtain tax treatment.

definition: External umbrella term for recognized religious ministers when law or institutions use that category.
avoid_or_caution: Not necessarily preferred internal self-description.

definition: Historical/theological category for a person claimed to speak through revelation; not an institutional office of the Assembly.
preferred_usage: study of prophets; claimed prophetic experience
avoid_or_caution: No person becomes institutionally unquestionable or gains office by claiming prophetic status.

definition: A reported or experienced event interpreted as contact with, disclosure from, or awareness of transcendent reality.
avoid_or_caution: Phenomenological description does not validate the interpretation.

definition: A person's or community's account of an encounter, conviction, event, or practice.
avoid_or_caution: Evidence to consider, not an automatic command.

definition: A person, text, artifact, practice, or source bearing evidence concerning an encounter, event, belief, or tradition.
avoid_or_caution: Witness does not mean proof of all attached theology.
crosswalk: Basis of Library of Witnesses terminology.

definition: The broad collection of religious/historical sources preserved for study, comparison, reconstruction, and theological work.
avoid_or_caution: Inclusion does not imply equal authority, reliability, inspiration, or doctrinal force.

definition: A claimed disclosure from God, the Divine, or transcendent reality.
avoid_or_caution: Prefer revelation claim when evidentiary status matters; no revelation claim bypasses consent, safeguarding, law, finance, or governance.

definition: Human assignment of meaning to an encounter, testimony, text, event, or tradition.
avoid_or_caution: Must remain distinguishable from the source/testimony itself.

definition: A proposition or practice currently taught with a stated status or confidence where appropriate.
preferred_usage: teaching of the Assembly; current teaching
avoid_or_caution: Repetition does not silently make teaching into binding doctrine.

definition: A teaching formally adopted with defined authority, scope, status, and implications.
avoid_or_caution: Do not label research conclusions, founder views, common opinions, or repeated teachings doctrine without the defined process.

definition: Doctrine actually adopted as binding by the competent religious authority through the required process.
avoid_or_caution: Drafts, release snapshots, research, personal revelation, and repository metadata are not binding doctrine.

definition: A source/corpus judged especially important to identity, historical reconstruction, or constructive theology.
avoid_or_caution: Does not itself mean infallible, inerrant, exclusive, or binding unless separately adopted.

definition: HTERP's constructive-theology reading/source-priority architecture.
preferred_usage: Always use the full qualified phrase on first use
avoid_or_caution: Never shorten to the canon in institutional or public governing documents.

definition: A formally bounded authoritative collection, if the Assembly ever constitutes one through an explicit process.
preferred_usage: canon of [source tradition]; future Way canon only if adopted
avoid_or_caution: No Way canon should be presumed from repository placement, HTERP inclusion, liturgical use, or historical importance.
decision_required: Yes — separate entrenched process if ever pursued

definition: A text regarded as scripture within a named tradition, or by the Assembly only if explicitly adopted as such.
preferred_usage: Jewish scripture; Islamic scripture; Christian scripture; Buddhist scriptures where appropriate
avoid_or_caution: Do not call the full Library of Witnesses our scripture.

definition: Umbrella phrase for spiritually significant texts, oral traditions, artifacts, practices, and records under study.
avoid_or_caution: Does not equal canon or equal authority.

definition: Disciplined investigation of religious, historical, philosophical, scientific, and experiential claims.
avoid_or_caution: Inquiry is not automatically doctrine and should not be framed as disloyalty.

definition: Individual and communal testing of claims, motives, interpretations, and proposed actions.
avoid_or_caution: Not a magic word that converts preference, charisma, or majority will into authority.

definition: The controlled repository home for current institutional instruments and records.
avoid_or_caution: Canonical here means designated repository home, not religious canon or adoption.

definition: The designated current repository home for a class of artifacts.
avoid_or_caution: Does not mean scriptural or doctrinal canon.

definition: Intentional address, attention, petition, thanksgiving, lament, praise, silence, or communion directed toward God/the Divine as understood by the person/community.
avoid_or_caution: Specific forms and metaphysical language may vary by adopted theology and conscience.

definition: Personal or communal acts oriented toward reverence of God/the Divine or the sacred.
avoid_or_caution: Do not use to settle unresolved theology of ultimate reality merely by vocabulary.

definition: Serious learning from primary sources, history, languages, scholarship, and lived traditions.
avoid_or_caution: Should distinguish source, interpretation, evidence, and conclusion.

definition: Voluntary action for the good of persons, communities, creatures, or the world.
avoid_or_caution: Do not condition aid on conversion, loyalty, donation, silence, or membership.

definition: A voluntary gift of money, goods, time, skill, or service.
avoid_or_caution: No offering purchases spiritual status, office, protection, revelation, or preference.

definition: A temporary voluntary period of intensified prayer, study, silence, fellowship, or reflection.
avoid_or_caution: No coercive isolation, deprivation, or exit restriction.

definition: Intentional recalling of God/the Divine, sacred history, persons, events, teachings, or obligations.
avoid_or_caution: Specific ritual meaning remains subject to theological development.

definition: A shared fellowship meal used in current pilot/curriculum materials to explore hospitality, equality, gratitude, and companionship.
preferred_usage: the Common Table; Fellowship: The Common Table
avoid_or_caution: Current repository sources still classify it as candidate rather than a fixed sacrament; do not overstate adoption until rite corpus is reconciled.
crosswalk: Candidate practice with active pilot use.
decision_required: Yes — reconcile later rite decisions into CH-011

definition: A written pattern of common practices and ethical commitments freely undertaken.
preferred_usage: personal Rule of Life; common Rule of Life
avoid_or_caution: Must not become coercive surveillance or a substitute for due process.

definition: Earlier project/community name appearing in the predecessor FOUND-series.
preferred_usage: Use only in historical provenance, quotation, or crosswalk records
avoid_or_caution: Do not introduce into new canonical drafting as the current identity unless explicitly restored by decision.
crosswalk: Predecessor to current Way/Assembly identity architecture.

definition: Earlier naming concept for the religious community/local communities.
preferred_usage: Use only when documenting naming history
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as a current proper name in new governing drafts unless intentionally revived.
crosswalk: Earlier naming exploration superseded in current working vocabulary by The Assembly / House of Prayer.

definition: Founder-centered identity formula.
avoid_or_caution: Do not use as a category for participants or adherents.

definition: Title implying personal spiritual domination or rank.
avoid_or_caution: Avoid as internal leadership title.

definition: Traditional theological/polemical labels that are not administrative categories of the Assembly.
preferred_usage: Use only when accurately discussing historical/source traditions
avoid_or_caution: Never use as organizational labels for former participants, critics, dissenters, or nonmembers.

definition: An artifact still subject to substantive change and not yet adopted merely by existence.
avoid_or_caution: Never equate draft with operative law/doctrine.

definition: An intentionally preserved release/version that should remain byte-stable.
avoid_or_caution: Release does not itself imply institutional adoption.

definition: An instrument approved through its applicable authoritative process with an adoption record preserved.
avoid_or_caution: Never use merely because a file sits in a canonical folder.

definition: A document or action actually signed/completed as required, with evidence preserved.
avoid_or_caution: Do not backdate or infer execution from a template.

definition: A document actually submitted to the relevant government/authority, with filing evidence preserved.
avoid_or_caution: Filing-ready or draft is not filed.

definition: Ambiguous status that may mean content-complete, approved, adopted, print-ready, or merely polished.
preferred_usage: Use CONTENT COMPLETE, APPROVED, ADOPTED/EXECUTED, PRINT MASTER, or PUBLISHED instead.
avoid_or_caution: Do not label a governing document final without specifying lifecycle state.

definition: The proofed, pagination-locked production version prepared for printing after substantive approvals are complete.
avoid_or_caution: Does not itself create adoption or legal effect.

definition: A prior artifact retained for provenance but no longer controlling for current use.
avoid_or_caution: Never delete solely because it is superseded.
